before_ingredients_html:
Simplified version

Instead of poaching, fry eggs in half the measured butter over medium-low heat, covered, for about 4–6 minutes until whites are fully set; cook longer for firm yolks. Use pasteurized eggs if serving soft yolks. Melt the remaining butter with chilli off the heat and spoon over eggs on garlic yoghurt.

intro_html: Warm poached eggs, cool thick yoghurt and a quick red-pepper butter. Planned for Göcek, Turkey · 24 October–around 7 November 2026. Also works in a home kitchen. See the seasonal shopping and supplier guide.

notes.html:
• Make the core ingredient list first.
  • Optional additions are separate; each is called out where it enters.
  • Quantities serve two.
  • Cook meat and seafood just before eating; keep dairy and raw ingredients refrigerated at 0–4 °C.
  • Prep vegetables before raw meat or use a separate board and clean tools.

steps.body_html:
• Mix yoghurt, garlic and salt.
  • Divide between two shallow bowls; let stand while you cook, rather than heating yoghurt to a boil.
  • Have optional bread ready before poaching.
steps.title: Make the yoghurt base

steps.body_html:
• Bring 6–8 cm of water to a bare simmer in a wide pot; add optional vinegar.
  • Crack each egg into a small cup, then slide it in close to the surface.
  • Cook two at a time; no vigorous whirlpool or rolling boil.
steps.title: Lower eggs into gentle water

steps.body_html:
• Poach about 3–4 minutes for fully set whites and a soft yolk.
  • Lift with a slotted spoon and drain on clean paper for 10 seconds.
  • Repeat for the other pair.
  • For firm yolks cook longer until set; use pasteurized eggs for soft-yolk service, especially for vulnerable diners.
steps.title: Poach; drain well

steps.body_html:
• Melt butter over low heat.
  • Turn off the heat, stir in pepper and let infuse 15–20 seconds without blackening.
  • Place two drained eggs on each yoghurt bowl; spoon butter over, add optional dill and eat immediately.
steps.title: Infuse butter; finish
